tunes.title: Let It Snow, Let It Snow, Let It Snow!
We Wish You a Merry Christmas
Darby O'Gill Fox Chase
tunes.notes: Programmatic piece depicting a fox hunt. Featured in the film Darby O'Gill and the Little People.

tunes.title: Dr. Gilbert's Reel
tunes.notes: Classic Irish reel. Famous recording by Michael Coleman (1929).

tunes.title: Gary Owen
tunes.notes: Strong accents, simple patterns in D. Known as a cavalry march tune in US history.

tunes.title: Martin Hayes Medley
tunes.notes: Transcription/arrangement in the style of Martin Hayes. Expressive, rubato playing.

tunes.title: Molly Ban
tunes.notes: Requires flexible timing, strong expressive control, ornamentation. Also known as 'Molly Bawn'.

tunes.title: Paddy Fahey's Jig
tunes.notes: Composed by the legendary East Galway fiddler Paddy Fahey.

tunes.title: Swallowtail Jig
tunes.notes: Classic jig bowing, repeated AABB form. Played widely in Em; considered beginner-friendly but can be ornamented.

tunes.title: Tam Lin
tunes.notes: Based on a Scottish/Irish border ballad. Also known as a reel version.

tunes.title: The Britches Full of Stitches
tunes.notes: Popular session jig with a memorable title.

tunes.title: The Butterfly
tunes.notes: Complex phrasing, ornaments, 9/8 groove. Many players treat it more as air-like slip jig.

tunes.title: The Connaughtman's Rambles
tunes.notes: Classic session jig from Connacht region.

tunes.title: The Gift of Falling
tunes.notes: Contemporary Celtic piece with lyrical phrasing.

tunes.title: The Musical Priest
tunes.notes: Popular session reel, often paired with other reels in a set.

tunes.title: The Trip to Sligo
tunes.notes: Classic Irish jig named after County Sligo.

tunes.title: Trip to Pakistan
tunes.notes: Modern reel with modal character. Associated with Martin Hayes.

tunes.title: Up Sligo
tunes.notes: Reel associated with the Sligo fiddle tradition.

tunes.title: Whiskey in the Jar
tunes.notes: Simple repetitive melody; great for group singing. Many lyric and melodic variants.
